question: Should OpenClaw permanently support plugin-authored AI-safety events and durable operator-queryable event history as a core SDK and state contract, or should this begin as a narrower core-only diagnostics seam?
rationale: The branch makes long-lived API, manifest, privacy, persistence, and operator-surface choices that cannot safely be inferred from implementation quality or CI alone.

options.title: Approve a narrower core seam
options.body: Land only an explicitly scoped core diagnostics contract first, deferring the public plugin emission API, durable retention policy, and broad UI surface to follow-up proposals.

options.title: Approve the full public contract
options.body: Adopt the plugin capability, manifest permission, durable history, and operator APIs as supported core behavior with named owners and upgrade/privacy documentation.

options.title: Keep it external or experimental
options.body: Require the telemetry workflow to prove itself through an external plugin or non-public experimental seam before adding permanent core contracts.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrower core seam
recommendation.body: Land only an explicitly scoped core diagnostics contract first, deferring the public plugin emission API, durable retention policy, and broad UI surface to follow-up proposals.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is primarily about repository scope and permanent extension boundaries rather than a mechanical patch repair.
